purpose: Sort 1 existing file into the layer of the target architecture that it moves to, when scripts/migration-sort cannot sort it.

state_fields.file.path: The path of the file, relative to the project root.
state_fields.file.content: The full text of the file.

layer.instructions: Which layer of the target architecture does most of the code in `file.content` belong to?

criteria.domain: Value types and pure functions that hold business rules: models, calculations, validation, state transitions. No views, no I/O, no system services.
criteria.feature: 1 screen or flow and its state: SwiftUI views, UIKit view controllers, and the models that drive them.
criteria.service: Code that talks to something outside the app process: network clients, storage, the Keychain, purchases, analytics, push notifications, and other system services.
criteria.shell: The app entry point and its composition: the @main app or the app delegate, the scene delegate, root navigation, construction of live services, and feature registration.
criteria.test: Unit tests, UI tests, test fakes, and test fixtures.
criteria.none: None of the other layers: for example generated code, a build script, or a file with no app code.

actions.domain: Move the code into an XDomain target.
actions.feature: Move the code into an XFeature target.
actions.service: Put the code behind a protocol in Core, with the live implementation in a service package.
actions.shell: Keep the code in the app target.
actions.test: Move the code into the test target of the code that it tests.
actions.none: Leave the file in place, and name it in the migration plan.
